name: command-center
description: What this session is on, at a glance, in any project: a bar above the prompt (ticket, branches and commits, worktree, environment, PRs, progress, usage), one side panel (overview, agents, files, GitHub, Jira, Vercel, controls), a card after each task (replay, what you should know, next actions), reflect, and a guard for risky commands. Enforces ims-nawy's rules inside ims-nawy.
